# Paths Generated by a Leaf

**Claim.** The path list generated by a leaf returning $a$ consists of the single path specifying no coordinates and having output $a$.

**Proof.** By the definition of the paths generated by a tree, a leaf returning $a$ produces the singleton list containing the empty path with output $a$. This is the stated equality by unfolding that defining case.
